newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Giribaldi ups CIR stake to 16.4pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Giribaldi ups CIR stake to 16.4pct.

text.p: Italian financier Luigi Giribaldi had raised his stake in industrial holding company CIR to 16.4 percent by May 27 from a level of 15.1 percent recorded in mid-March, a statement from the Milan bourse said on Tuesday.
Giribaldi has entrusted his CIR stake to the Banque du Gothard, and the bank holds a further 0.1 percent stake in CIR which it holds for other investors.
Newspaper reports have suggested that Giribaldi's stake in CIR has risen to around 17 percent, with Milan financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore putting it at 17.5 percent in its June 14 issue.

Lastest figures show that Giribaldi also has a 20 percent stake in Cofide the holding company of Carlo De Benedetti. Cofide has a controlling stake in CIR which in turn is still the largest single shareholder in information and technology group Olivetti with a stake of 6.29 percent recorded in April, but CIR aims to cut this to five percent.
Giribaldi also has a one percent stake in Olivetti, which holds its annual shareholders meeting on June 18.
